_provenance.call: every line matching `hit your .*limit` in ~/.config/kipi/linear-worker.log, paired with the `fail ASK-N rc=R (n/max)` line that followed it within five lines
_provenance.redaction: none: the lines carry issue ids, timestamps and the CLI's own text, no names or paths
_provenance.note: A real capture. 61 failures across 30 issues, each charged as an attempt although the runner itself was refusing; 26 issues reached the attempt cap on that charge alone. ASK-2009's replay: with the classifier in place, none may be charged.
